title: Angelic Wisdom Concerning the Divine Love and the Divine Wisdom
author: Emanuel Swedenborg
description: Swedenborg examines love and wisdom as principles in creation and the human mind in James John Garth Wilkinson’s English translation.
editionNote: 1883 edition. London: James Speirs, 36 Bloomsbury Street. Edition credit: J.J. Garth Wilkinson (1812–1899).
